root_idea.summary: The root centers on roundness, circular form, and movement in a circuit.
root_idea.development: From the basic notion of circularity, the lexicon extends to round or hemispherical objects and land formations, the revolving celestial sphere and its courses, circling water, and the ship as a vessel moving through water.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The form denotes the celestial orbit or course and is lexically distinct from فُلْك meaning ship or ships.
The form is the Quranic noun for a ship or ships.

senses.definition: The orbit or celestial course in which heavenly bodies move.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic expression describing each celestial body as moving or swimming in its own falak.

senses.definition: A ship or vessel; the same form may denote a single ship or ships collectively.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun is used in both singular and plural senses, with grammatical agreement and context determining the intended number. It also includes the ark in the Quranic account of Noah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a breast, to become rounded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal use describing the development of a rounded breast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place a round piece of hair or a twig around or through the tongue of a nursing young camel so that it cannot suckle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral construction involving the tongue of a young, unweaned camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist or persevere in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal use meaning to persist in or press on with a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bitch, to desire mating and discharge blood from the womb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of an animal's reproductive condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The celestial sphere or revolving vault in which the stars are set and move.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A cosmological use, including the imagined material sphere or firmament surrounding the heavenly bodies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pole or axis of heaven.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical expression, likened to the pivot or axis of a millstone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The circuit or principal central part of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general nominal use for a circuit or main portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Circling waves of the sea, or water stirred into circular, back-and-forth motion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of water in a state of commotion and circulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hill or mound of sand surrounded by a broad expanse of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical description of a prominent sandy elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A circular, elevated tract or piece of land or sand, often rough or uneven in surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of rounded elevated formations standing above the surrounding ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for one with rounded or large buttocks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily description based on resemblance to the round spindle whorl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick- or coarse-jointed, or loose-boned and flaccid in build.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical description of the body's joints, bones, or general constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having pain in the patella.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily condition expressed with reference to the kneecap.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The round or nearly hemispherical whorl of a spindle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is associated with the object's circular form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A round piece of coarse hair or similar material inserted into the tongue of a nursing young camel to prevent suckling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral implement; it is the object used in the corresponding verbal construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small, compact-topped rocky eminence or mound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The summit is compared in shape to a spindle whorl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything circular.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general nominal use based on circular form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The joint or cartilaginous disk between two vertebrae of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use referring to the intervertebral structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The kneecap or patella.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The small structure at the head or root of the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use for the small rounded structure at the tongue's base.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side or rounded part of the horse's breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical or descriptive use referring to the زَوْر region of a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Celestial or relating to the celestial sphere.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive adjective derived from فَلَك in its astronomical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An astronomer or astrologer, one occupied with the science of the stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized use of the celestial adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small ship or boat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A diminutive form of فُلْك used as a lexicalized noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A breast that is becoming rounded, or an epithet for such a breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form describes development that has not reached the fuller state expressed by نَوَاهِد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A baker's rolling pin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun; its Arabicized status is reported in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Papyrus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate lexical use of the same form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tar or pitch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material noun synonymous with قَار or زِفْت.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression قَوْسٌ فَيْلَكُونٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who goes around a sand hill or mound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description is based on moving around a فَلَك understood as a sandy mound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two fleshy portions bordering the uvula.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical plural or dual expression.

cautions: فُلْك may be interpreted as singular or plural, and its grammatical gender varies with the intended number and construction.
The Quranic forms فَلَك and فُلْك are distinct in vocalization and meaning: celestial orbit versus ship or ships.
Several Classical entries preserve rare anatomical, pastoral, technical, or specialized uses that are not Quranic senses.
